articles.title_en: Trust and State Effectiveness: The Political Economy of Compliance
articles.title_cn: 信任与国家效能：合规的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the link between trust in government, policymaking and compliance. It focuses on a specific channel whereby citizens who are convinced of the merits of a policy are more motivated to comply with it. This, in turn, reduces the government’s cost of implementing this policy and may also increase the set of feasible interventions. As a result, state effectiveness is greater when citizens trust their government. The paper discusses alternative approaches to modelling the origins of trust, especially the link to the design of political institutions. We then provide empirical evidence consistent with the model’s findings that compliance is increasing in government trust using the Integrated Values Survey and voluntary compliance during COVID-19 in the United Kingdom.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了政府信任、政策制定与合规之间的联系。它聚焦于一个特定渠道，即相信政策优点的公民更有动力遵守政策。这反过来降低了政府实施该政策的成本，并可能增加可行干预措施的范围。因此，当公民信任政府时，国家效能更高。本文讨论了模拟信任起源的替代方法，特别是与政治制度设计的联系。然后，我们使用综合价值观调查和英国COVID-19期间的自愿合规，提供了与模型发现一致的实证证据，即合规随政府信任而增加。

articles.title_en: The Shale Revolution and the Dynamics of the Oil Market
articles.title_cn: 页岩革命与石油市场动态
articles.abstract_en: We build and estimate a dynamic, structural model of the world oil market to quantify the impact of the shale revolution. We model the shale revolution as a decrease in shale production costs and find that the resultant increase in shale production lowers oil prices by 24% in the short run and 48% once the shale oil transition is complete. Current oil price volatility is lowered by 8% to 23% depending on the horizon. We also find that OPEC core acts to keep its market share constant in the face of the dramatic increase in shale production.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建并估计了一个世界石油市场的动态结构模型，以量化页岩革命的影响。我们将页岩革命建模为页岩生产成本下降，并发现由此导致的页岩产量增加在短期内使油价降低24%，而在页岩油转型完成后则降低48%。当前油价波动性根据时间跨度的不同降低了8%至23%。我们还发现，面对页岩产量的急剧增加，OPEC核心国家致力于保持其市场份额不变。

articles.title_en: Special Interest Groups Versus Voters and the Political Economics of Attention
articles.title_cn: 特殊利益集团与选民及注意力的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: We investigate whether US House representatives favour special interest groups over constituents in periods of low media attention to politics. Analysing 666 roll calls from 2005 to 2018, we show that representatives are more likely to vote against their constituency’s preferred position the more special interest money they receive from groups favouring the opposite position. The latter effect is significantly larger when less attention is paid to politics due to distraction by exogenous newsworthy events like natural disasters. The effect is mostly driven by short-term opportunistic behaviour than the short-term scheduling of controversial votes in periods with high news pressure.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在媒体对政治关注度较低的时期，美国众议院议员是否更倾向于偏袒特殊利益集团而非选民。通过分析2005年至2018年的666次唱名表决，我们发现，议员从支持相反立场的团体那里获得的特殊利益资金越多，他们越有可能投票反对其选区的偏好立场。当由于自然灾害等外部有新闻价值的事件分散注意力而导致对政治的关注度较低时，后一种效应显著更大。这种效应主要由短期机会主义行为驱动，而非在新闻压力大的时期安排有争议投票的短期时间安排。

articles.title_en: Bundling Genetic and Financial Technologies for More Resilient and Productive Small-Scale Farmers in Africa
articles.title_cn: 捆绑遗传与金融技术以提升非洲小农户的韧性与生产力
articles.abstract_en: Using a multi-year, spatially diversified randomised controlled trial spanning two African countries, this paper explores whether a complementary bundle of genetic and financial technologies can boost the resilience and productivity of small-scale farmers. The analysis shows that both moderate droughts and more severe yield losses undermine the resilience of control-group households, and that these shocks have long-lasting effects as farmers invest and produce less following shocks. Severe yield shocks also increase hunger and food insecurity. The genetic technology—drought-tolerant seeds—provides economically significant protection against mid-season drought and mitigates the long-term drop in farm productivity seen in the control group. The financial technology—satellite-based index insurance—offsets the long-term consequences of severe yield losses that are not mitigated by the drought-tolerant seeds. Finally, the analysis shows that treatment-group farmers who experienced shocks and saw the technologies in action subsequently increased their agricultural investment beyond pre-shock levels, an effect we call the resilience dividend. Unfortunately, this apparent experiential learning cuts both ways. Farmers who did not experience the efficacy of the risk management technologies backed away from using them. Our findings thus showcase how genetic and financial risk-mitigating technologies can offer farmers more complete protection, as well as the challenge of inducing sustained uptake of technologies that are midway between experience and credence goods and only infrequently reveal their benefits.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用一项跨越两个非洲国家、多年期、空间多样化的随机对照试验，探讨互补的遗传与金融技术捆绑能否提升小农户的韧性和生产力。分析表明，中度干旱和更严重的产量损失均削弱了对照组家庭的韧性，且这些冲击具有长期影响，因为农户在冲击后投资和产出减少。严重的产量冲击还加剧了饥饿和粮食不安全。遗传技术——耐旱种子——对季中干旱提供了经济上显著的保护，并缓解了对照组中观察到的农场生产力长期下降。金融技术——基于卫星的指数保险——抵消了耐旱种子未能缓解的严重产量损失的长期后果。最后，分析显示，经历冲击并目睹技术发挥作用的处理组农户，随后将其农业投资增加到冲击前水平以上，我们将这一效应称为韧性红利。不幸的是，这种明显的经验学习是双向的。未经历风险管理技术效用的农户则回避使用这些技术。因此，我们的研究结果展示了遗传和金融风险缓解技术如何为农户提供更全面的保护，以及诱导持续采用介于经验品和信任品之间且仅偶尔显现其益处的技术所面临的挑战。

articles.title_en: A Theory of Small Campaign Contributions
articles.abstract_en: Popular and academic discussions have mostly concentrated on large donors, even though small donors are a major source of financing for political campaigns. We propose a theory of small donors with a key novelty: it centres on the interactions between small donors and the parties’ fundraising strategy. In equilibrium, parties micro-target donors with a higher contribution potential (that is, richer and with more intense preferences) and increase their total fundraising effort in close races. The parties’ strategic fundraising amplifies the effect of income on contributions, and leads to closeness, underdog and bandwagon effects. We then study the welfare effects of a number of common campaign finance laws. We find that, due to equilibrium effects, those tools may produce outcomes opposite to intended objectives. Finally, we identify a tax-and-subsidy scheme that mutes the effect of income while still allowing donors to voice the intensity of their support.
articles.abstract_cn: 大众和学术讨论大多集中于大额捐赠者，尽管小额捐赠者是政治竞选融资的主要来源。我们提出了一个关于小额捐赠者的理论，其关键新颖之处在于：它聚焦于小额捐赠者与政党筹款策略之间的互动。在均衡状态下，政党会微观定位具有更高捐款潜力（即更富有且偏好更强烈）的捐赠者，并在竞争激烈的竞选中增加其总筹款努力。政党的策略性筹款放大了收入对捐款的影响，并导致竞争激烈、弱势方和从众效应。随后，我们研究了几种常见竞选财务法的福利效应。我们发现，由于均衡效应，这些工具可能产生与预期目标相反的结果。最后，我们确定了一种税收和补贴方案，该方案能抑制收入的影响，同时仍允许捐赠者表达其支持的强度。

articles.title_en: Sharing News Left and Right: Frictions and Misinformation on Twitter
articles.title_cn: 左右共享新闻：Twitter上的摩擦与错误信息
articles.abstract_en: On 20 October 2020, prior to the US presidential election, Twitter modified its user interface for sharing social media posts. In an effort to reduce the spread of misinformation on the platform, the new interface nudged users to be thoughtful about the content they were sharing. Using data on over 160,000 tweets by US news media outlets, we show that this policy significantly reduced news sharing, but that the reductions varied heterogeneously by political slant: sharing of content fell significantly more for left-wing outlets relative to right-wing outlets. Examining Twitter activity data for news-sharing users, we find that conservatives were less responsive to Twitter’s intervention. Lastly, using web traffic data, we document that the policy significantly reduced visits to news media outlets’ websites.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2020年十月20日，美国总统大选之前，Twitter修改了其用于分享社交媒体帖子的用户界面。为了减少平台上错误信息的传播，新界面引导用户在分享内容时更加深思熟虑。利用美国新闻媒体发布的超过160,000条推文数据，我们表明这一政策显著减少了新闻分享，但减少幅度因政治倾向而异：左翼媒体的内容分享下降幅度显著大于右翼媒体。通过检查新闻分享用户的Twitter活动数据，我们发现保守派对Twitter干预的响应程度较低。最后，利用网络流量数据，我们记录了该政策显著减少了新闻媒体网站的访问量。

articles.title_en: Telementoring and Homeschooling During School Closures: a Randomised Experiment in Rural Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 学校关闭期间的远程辅导与家庭教育：孟加拉国农村的一项随机实验
articles.abstract_en: Using a randomised experiment in 200 Bangladeshi villages, we evaluate the impact of an over-the-phone learning support intervention (telementoring) among primary school children and their mothers during Covid-19 school closures. Post-intervention, treated children scored 35% higher on a standardised test, and the homeschooling involvement of treated mothers increased by 22 minutes per day (26%). We also found that the intervention forestalled treated children's learning losses. When we returned to the participants one year later, after schools briefly reopened, we found that the treatment effects had persisted. Academically weaker children benefited the most from the intervention that only cost USD20 per child.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用在孟加拉国200个村庄进行的随机实验，我们评估了在Covid-19学校关闭期间，针对小学生及其母亲的一项电话学习支持干预（远程辅导）的影响。干预后，受治疗儿童在标准化测试中的得分高出35%，受治疗母亲的居家教育参与度每天增加22分钟（26%）。我们还发现，该干预措施阻止了受治疗儿童的学习损失。一年后，当学校短暂重新开放时，我们再次访问参与者，发现治疗效果仍然持续。学业较弱的儿童从这项仅花费每个儿童20美元的干预中受益最多。

articles.abstract_en: Does academic writing in economics reflect the political orientation of economists? We use machine learning to measure partisanship in academic economics articles. We predict the observed political behaviour of a subset of economists using phrases from their academic articles, show good out-of-sample predictive accuracy and then predict partisanship for all economists. We then use these predictions to examine patterns of political language in economics. We estimate journal-specific effects on predicted ideology, controlling for author and year fixed effects, that accord with existing survey-based measures. We show considerable sorting of economists into fields of research by predicted partisanship. We also show that partisanship is detectable even within fields, even across those estimating the same theoretical parameter. Using policy-relevant parameters collected from previous meta-analyses, we then show that imputed partisanship is correlated with estimated parameters, such that the implied policy prescription is consistent with partisan leaning. For example, we find that going from the most left-wing authored estimate of the taxable top income elasticity to the most right-wing authored estimate decreases the optimal tax rate from 77% to 60%.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学学术写作是否反映了经济学家的政治倾向？我们使用机器学习来衡量经济学学术文章中的党派性。我们利用一组经济学家的学术文章中的短语来预测他们可观察到的政治行为，显示出良好的样本外预测准确性，然后预测所有经济学家的党派性。接着，我们利用这些预测来考察经济学中的政治语言模式。我们估计了期刊特定效应对预测意识形态的影响，并控制了作者和年份固定效应，这与现有的基于调查的测量结果一致。我们展示了经济学家按预测党派性在研究领域中的显著分类。我们还表明，即使在领域内部，甚至在估计相同理论参数的研究者之间，党派性也是可检测的。利用先前元分析中收集的政策相关参数，我们进一步表明，估算的党派性与估计参数相关，使得隐含的政策建议与党派倾向一致。例如，我们发现，从最左翼作者对可征税最高收入弹性的估计到最右翼作者的估计，最优税率从77%降至60%。

articles.abstract_en: Many products sold on online platforms have additional features like fees for services, shipping, luggage, upgrades, and so on. We study when a two-sided platform shrouds additional features towards potentially naive buyers. We explore a novel mechanism according to which platforms shroud to manipulate network externalities between buyers and sellers. Exploring this mechanism, we argue the advent of online marketplaces led to less transparent markets. First, platforms have stronger incentives to shroud seller fees than sellers themselves. Second, platforms shroud their own fees less if they earn more revenue from sellers; so when sellers on the platform compete more fiercely, platforms—somewhat perversely—shroud more. We connect these results to many applications and the current debate on regulating online platforms.
articles.abstract_cn: 在线平台上销售的许多产品具有额外特性，如服务费、运费、行李费、升级费等。我们研究双边平台何时会向可能天真的买家隐藏这些额外特性。我们探索了一种新机制，即平台通过隐藏信息来操纵买卖双方之间的网络外部性。通过探索这一机制，我们认为在线市场的出现导致了市场透明度降低。首先，平台隐藏卖家费用的激励比卖家自身更强。其次，如果平台从卖家那里获得更多收入，它们隐藏自身费用的程度会降低；因此，当平台上的卖家竞争更加激烈时，平台——有些反常地——会隐藏更多信息。我们将这些结果与许多应用以及当前关于监管在线平台的辩论联系起来。

articles.title_en: Immigration and The Short- and Long-Term Impact of Improved Prenatal Conditions
articles.title_cn: 移民与产前条件改善的短期和长期影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of immigration from a developing country to a developed country during pregnancy on offspring outcomes. We focus on intermediate- and long-term outcomes, using quasi-experimental variation created by the immigration of Ethiopian Jews to Israel in May 1991. Individuals conceived before immigration experienced dramatic changes in their environmental conditions at different stages of prenatal development depending on their gestational age at migration. We find that females whose mothers immigrated at an earlier gestational age have better educational outcomes. They also tend to work more as adults. In contrast, we do not find any effect among males.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了怀孕期间从发展中国家移民到发达国家对后代结果的影响。我们关注中期和长期结果，利用1991年五月埃塞俄比亚犹太人移民到以色列所创造的准实验变异。在移民前受孕的个体，根据其移民时的胎龄，在产前发育的不同阶段经历了环境条件的剧烈变化。我们发现，母亲在较早胎龄移民的女性有更好的教育结果。她们成年后也倾向于工作更多。相比之下，我们在男性中没有发现任何影响。

articles.title_en: Accommodating the Rise in Urbanisation: Are New Towns a Good Solution?
articles.title_cn: 适应城市化进程的崛起：新城是好的解决方案吗？
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the performance of New Towns, that is, planned large urban sub-centres, as a central tool to accommodate the global rise in urbanisation. A spatial quantifiable general equilibrium framework suitable to study large-scale urban master plans is presented. The framework is then used to investigate the equilibrium effects of five New Towns developed in the 1970s in Paris’s metropolitan area. By 2015, the development of New Towns appears to have increased metropolitan population ($+$18%), metropolitan gross domestic product ($+$11%) and reduced average commuting times (−6.9%). The results obtained for Paris’s metropolitan area are externally validated using a difference-in-differences approach on all 314 New Towns developed worldwide between 1992 and 2012.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了新城（即规划的大型城市副中心）作为适应全球城市化进程崛起的核心工具的表现。文中提出了一个适用于研究大规模城市总体规划的空间可量化一般均衡框架。该框架随后被用于研究巴黎大都市区在1970年开发的五个新城的均衡效应。到2015年，新城的发展似乎增加了大都市人口（$+$18%）、大都市国内生产总值（$+$11%），并减少了平均通勤时间（−6.9%）。通过使用双重差分方法对1992年至2012年间全球开发的314个新城进行外部验证，巴黎大都市区所得结果得到了验证。

articles.title_en: Kinship Taxation as an Impediment to Growth: Experimental Evidence from Kenyan Microenterprises
articles.title_cn: 亲属税作为增长的障碍：来自肯尼亚微型企业的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper documents strong pressure to share income faced by entrepreneurs in a developing country setting. This ‘kinship tax’ can distort productive decisions, including investment. A lab experiment with 361 Kenyan entrepreneurs reveals that a third of them face distortionary pressure to share income. This kinship tax is higher for men, and increasing in entrepreneurial ability. Using a pre-existing randomised cash transfer experiment, I find that only male entrepreneurs who do not face distortionary kinship taxation invest these transfers. Imposing some parametric assumptions, I estimate that kinship taxation decreases aggregate productivity among firms in this sample by one-quarter.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文记录了发展中国家环境中企业家面临的分享收入的强大压力。这种“亲属税”可能扭曲生产决策，包括投资。一项针对361名肯尼亚企业家的实验室实验显示，其中三分之一面临分享收入的扭曲性压力。这种亲属税对男性更高，并随企业家能力增强而增加。利用一项预先存在的随机现金转移实验，我发现只有不面临扭曲性亲属税的男性企业家才会投资这些转移资金。在施加一些参数假设的情况下，我估计亲属税使该样本中企业的总生产率降低了四分之一。

articles.title_en: Why High Incentives Cause Repugnance: a Framed Field Experiment
articles.title_cn: 为什么高激励会引起反感：一个框架田野实验
articles.abstract_en: Why are high monetary payments prohibited for certain goods, thereby causing shortages in their supply? I conduct (i) a framed field experiment with a general population sample and (ii) a survey experiment with this sample and with ethics committees. In the experiment, participants can prohibit others from being offered money to register as stem-cell donors. I document that, whereas the majority of participants do not respond to changes in the incentives (63%) or become more in favour of the offer with higher incentives (20%), a minority of 17% prohibit high incentives. I show that this minority wants to protect individuals who are persuaded by high incentives. I also show that a lottery scheme reduces their objections to high incentives. Finally, I document that the public is much more supportive of high incentives than are ethics committees.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么某些商品禁止高额货币支付，从而导致其供应短缺？我进行了（i）一个针对普通人群样本的框架田野实验和（ii）一个针对该样本及伦理委员会的调查实验。在实验中，参与者可以禁止他人被提供金钱以登记为干细胞捐赠者。我记录到，尽管大多数参与者对激励变化没有反应（63%）或随着激励提高而更加支持该提议（20%），但少数参与者（17%）禁止高激励。我表明，这一少数群体希望保护那些被高激励所说服的个人。我还表明，抽奖方案减少了他们对高激励的反对。最后，我记录到公众对高激励的支持程度远高于伦理委员会。

articles.title_en: Borrowing Constraints and Demand for Remedial Education: Evidence from Tanzania
articles.title_cn: 借贷约束与补习教育需求：来自坦桑尼亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use a cash transfer to relax households’ borrowing constraints, then elicit their willingness to pay for a remedial education programme offering tutoring and life skills training. Lottery losers were willing to pay 3,300 Tanzanian Shillings for the programme, which is 7% of per capita monthly expenditures. For those identified at baseline as able to borrow, willingness to pay increases by 3% upon winning a lottery prize of 3,200 Tanzanian Shillings. For those unable to borrow, willingness to pay increases by 27% upon winning the lottery. We conclude that borrowing constraints limit access to educational programmes, and may increase inequality of educational attainment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用现金转移来放松家庭的借贷约束，然后引出他们对提供辅导和生活技能培训的补习教育项目的支付意愿。彩票输家愿意为该计划支付3,300坦桑尼亚先令，这相当于人均月支出的7%。对于在基线时被识别为能够借贷的人，赢得3,200坦桑尼亚先令的彩票奖金后，支付意愿增加了3%。对于无法借贷的人，赢得彩票后支付意愿增加了27%。我们得出结论，借贷约束限制了教育项目的获取，并可能加剧教育成就的不平等。

articles.title_en: Spending and Pricing to Deter Arbitrage
articles.title_cn: 支出与定价以阻止套利
articles.abstract_en: This article presents examples of arbitrage deterrence from the pharmaceutical, chemical and auto industries. Based on these cases, it develops two models where a monopolist prices and spends to deter arbitrage. The models differ in whether the lower price is set by the firm or negotiated with a representative of consumers. In both models, imports into the high-price market are completely deterred, but the two markets are nonetheless linked by the threat of arbitrage. If this linkage is ignored and the absence of arbitrage is misattributed to exogenous factors, econometric estimates of firm bargaining power will be biased upwards.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了来自制药、化工和汽车行业的套利阻止案例。基于这些案例，本文构建了两个模型，其中垄断者通过定价和支出来阻止套利。这两个模型的区别在于较低价格是由企业设定还是与消费者代表协商确定。在两个模型中，高价市场的进口被完全阻止，但两个市场仍然通过套利的威胁而联系在一起。如果忽略这种联系，并将套利的缺失错误地归因于外生因素，那么对企业议价能力的计量经济学估计将存在向上偏误。
